title: feat(platform-objects): sys_personal_view, a reader's own named list views, with the owner's delete door (server step)
body: domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY _Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9RdqjLGpNWRr2BGJHkC5giq)_ Fixes #29443 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none Clause-② measured: on base (`origin/main` @ `81cd9eb0`), `sys_personal_view` does not exist, so every `/api/v1/data/sys_personal_view` call is refused as an unknown object. No registrar mounts `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id` there (read from the source; not driven over HTTP on base). On head both are served, and the dogfood file below is 16/16. No existing answer narrows: the only grants added name the new object, no shipped set loses anything, and the generic data `DELETE` keeps answering what it answered (pinned). Metadata-protocol stays `none`. This is a platform object holding user data, not a key, value or metadata type an author writes, and `/meta` does not serve it (pinned). This closes the server step of #29443: read, create, rename, and the owner's own delete. Which view opens by default stays with the Console's existing per-object pin (see *Round 2*). The Console half follows on the card. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：新增平台对象 `sys_personal_view`（个人视图）。一行就是某个用户为某个对象保存的一个命名列表视图，含所有者、对象名、名称和 ListView 配置。通用数据 API 可以读、建、改名。默认视图不在这里存，沿用 Console 已有的按对象置顶（`list.view.pinned`，#27594）。另外新增一个所有者删除门 `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`，只能删除调用者自己的视图。 - **为什么改**：依据 #28971 裁决 C，「我的视图」是用户数据，不是视图元数据。这是第一版的服务端一半，以 `sys_user_preference` 为模板。删除门按席位裁决 6583289013 建，沿用 #26161 字母 A 的形状。 - **风险与回滚**：这是纯新增对象和新增路由，已有对象和已有答复都不变。行级范围只到所有者本人；组织管理员的通配绕过对该对象已关闭，读不到、改不了、也删不了成员的视图（都答 404）。平台管理员（`admin_full_access`）保留通配：通过通用数据 API 能读、改、删任何成员的视图，和 `sys_user_preference` 的现状一致，已有测试钉住，并列为待决问题；只有本 PR 的删除门拒绝他删别人的视图（403）。外部成员本版没有授权，也列为待决问题。视图的所有者在保存时确定，任何非系统调用都不能改 `user_id`（403）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR，表留着无害。 - **先看**：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-personal-view.object.ts`；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-hooks.ts`；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.ts`；`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts` 里的两处新条目。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/personal-view-hooks.test.ts src/personal-view-routes.test.ts`，预期 35 个全绿；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/personal-view-row-scope.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 16 个全绿。 - **需要你做的**：无。路由名 `/api/v1/personal-views/:id` 已由席位接受；两个待决问题（平台管理员的通配、外部成员）见文末。 ## What changes - **New platform object `sys_personal_view`** (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-personal-view.object.ts`). plugin-auth's identity manifest registers it right after `sys_user_preference`, on the same template. - Fields: `user_id` (owner, lookup `sys_user`), `object_name`, `label` (the name the owner gave it), `config` (json, spec's `ListView` shape), and `created_at` / `updated_at`. There is no default column: which view opens by default is the Console's existing pin (see *Round 2*). - It is `managedBy: 'system-data'` and `access: { default: 'private' }`, so a plain (non-super-user) `'*'` wildcard does not reach it. A wildcard carrying `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords` still does (ADR-0066 D2): `organization_admin`'s is closed below, and `admin_full_access`'s is not. - It declares the owner-only `defaultRowScope` `user_id == current_user.id` for every operation. - The table carries the organization column, so the Layer 0 wall bounds it too (ADR-0131). The regenerated tenancy census counts it in reach. - **Two write rules** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-hooks.ts`). Both registrars register them: `AuthPlugin` on `kernel:ready`, and `IdentityObjectsPlugin.start()` on a kernel without auth. - **The body must be a `ListView` for the row's own object.** A create, and an update that sends `config` or `object_name`, parse the resulting body with spec's `ListViewSchema`; an update fills whichever of the two it did not send from the stored row. A body that does not parse is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` (an existing code, through `validationFailure`), with one `fields[]` entry per issue, each path under `config`. Text that is not JSON is refused the same way, with the single field `config`. A body whose `data.object` names another object than `object_name` is refused the same way, on `config.data.object` (code `object_mismatch`). A rename that sends neither is not re-judged. - **The owner is fixed when the view is saved.** An update that changes `user_id` is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` for every caller but the system, platform administrators included; an echo of the stored owner is no change. The row scope alone does not hold this for an organization member: `member_default`'s `'*'` update floor (`created_by == current_user.id`, positions `org_member`) is a held update policy, so the object's declared default does not apply to an update, and a re-parent's post-image still carries the member's own `created_by`. The round-2 battery found it (REST `PATCH user_id` answered 200). - **The owner's delete door, `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-routes.ts`). Seat ruling 6583289013; it takes the shape of #26161's unreact door, ruling 6422861164 letter A. `AuthPlugin` mounts it on the kernel's HTTP server, next to its auth routes. It removes one row, and only the caller's own: 1. The caller is resolved through the one composition, `resolveRequestExecutionContext`. 2. Anonymous is refused `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`. 3. A held sign-in gets its policy's `403`. 4. A query parameter is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. 5. The row is read **as the caller**. Another member, an organization administrator, and an unknown id all get `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. 6. A row the caller can read but does not own (`user_id !== caller`; today only a platform administrator reads one) is refused loudly with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, and the row stays. This is the door's own answer; the platform administrator's generic data `DELETE` is not refused (see Grants). 7. Only then is the row removed, as the system, with `attributedUserId` set to the caller and inside the caller's organization. The answer is `200 { id, deleted: true }`. No grant moves: `member_default` is unchanged, and the generic data `DELETE` of the owner's own row is still `403` (pinned). **Route name:** `/api/v1/personal-views/:id`, the unreact door's convention (a plural resource noun under `/api/v1`, the record id in the path, no query). The seat accepted it in review. - Its ledger row: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/personal-view-route-ledger.ts` (`gap`: the Console's My views list is the consumer, and the SDK has no method yet), with `personal-view-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`. - Its `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` declaration (`responses: 0, ok: 0, err: 0`; every body goes through the shared pair). - Its `scripts/check-single-authz-resolver.mjs` delegator row. - Its removal is one new elevated write call site in the tenant audit census. `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` regenerated the artefacts (256 sites), and the hand-written figures on `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` follow it (255 → 256, 78 → 79, 145 → 146). - A server that registers no `DELETE` verb (a partial embedding, or a test double) skips the door with a warning that names it, instead of failing the boot. - **Grants** (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`): - `member_default`: read, create and edit on `sys_personal_view`, and **no delete**. The set is bound to the `everyone` anchor, which may not carry a delete bit (ADR-0090 D5). - `organization_admin` (and the derived `organization_admin_no_bypass`): an explicit `sys_personal_view` entry with no `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords`. For this object it overrides the wildcard's super-user bits, the `sys_audit_log` pattern. An organization administrator reads, writes and deletes only their own views. - `admin_full_access` is untouched (seat ruling 6587007982). Its wildcard carries `viewAllRecords` and `modifyAllRecords`, so through the generic data API it **reads, edits and deletes** every member's view, exactly as it does `sys_user_preference` today. Its pins forbid a per-object entry there, and the rescue path depends on it. Pinned as a recorded boundary at engine and REST level; listed as an open question below. Only the owner's door refuses it (`403`). - `external_default` gets **no** grant in this version: an external member cannot save a personal view. Listed as an open question for the Console half. - **The id** is the engine's record id (nanoid). It never contains `.`, so it can never be read as `object.key` view syntax (pinned). - **Not view metadata:** `/meta/view` does not list a personal view, and `/meta/view/` answers 404 (pinned). There is no metadata type, no package export and no metadata write door. - **The only spec touch** (allowed by seat ruling, recorded in round 2): one line, `'sys_personal_view'` in `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']` (`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts`). Nothing else under `packages/spec` changes. - **Rosters:** - the CLI organization-ownership inventory row (`fate: 'attribution'`); - the i18n extract config; - the en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES object bundles, regenerated and then translated by hand; - `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json`, regenerated (92 registered / 47 in reach). - `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: row 26c owns the owner rule's system skip (`ctx.session.isSystem`), and the generated site register is rewritten with `--write` (166 read sites). - **Changeset** `.changeset/29443-personal-views-server.md`: patch for platform-objects, plugin-auth, plugin-security, cli **and spec** (the spec package publishes a changed constant, and AGENTS.md asks every publishing change to carry a changeset). Not in scope, and not touched: sharing, team views, admin management, a field picker, packaging, any `ui/**` change, #29037's `ViewScopeSchema.personal` / `sharing.type`, and a shared own-row door helper (review S3; the seat files it as a follow-up card). ## Round 2 (review issuecomment-6586971553, seat ruling issuecomment-6587007982) - **M1, no stored default.** The `is_default` column and the one-default hook are gone. The default is the Console's existing pin `LIST_PINNED_VIEW_PREFERENCE` (`list.view.pinned`, #27594, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts`). **Finding:** the pin can hold a personal view's id as it is. It stores `{"view": , "v": 1}` for any non-empty string, and `ObjectView` resolves it with `resolveViewId(pinned, views.map(v => v.id), objectName)`, whose first step is an exact id match. So it works once the Console half lists personal views in `views`. A nanoid has no `.`, so the bare-key qualification step (`
